annotations.caption: A metal grated structure in fog.

A grated metal structure obscures the foreground which is also comprised of a rural road on a grassy area. Evergreens, and other trees, stand in the scene next to large areas of mounds of dirt. Haze appears to be in the air.

A wide, prairie plain with green grass and yellow wildflowers with a road running through it. In the background, a wide expanse of water is visible with trees on the banks.

Two images of the same scene in which the left is a standard image and the right is it's thermal representation. An open, brown and green grassy field with a road running through it is in the foreground. A building sits in the background with trees nearby.

A standard image and its thermal representation of a lush, green plain with white and yellow wild-flowers and a road running through it. Buildings by trees are in the background and an expanse of water is visible.
Two deer enter a wide, prairie plain with green grass and yellow wildflowers with a road running through it. In the background, a wide expanse of water is visible with trees on the banks.
Two images of the same scene in which there is an illuminated instrument. On the left is the standard image and the right its thermal representation.

A blue sky with clouds blocking sun over a wide and green grassy plain with brown, bare foliage throughout has a road running through it and an expanse of water visible in the background with trees on either side.
A dark, night sky filled with stars.
An overcast, grey scene in which treetops are in the foreground and a metal component is visible in the top-right.
A component box and antenna stand over a brown and somewhat green grassy area with green trees and foliage to the right. A field is in the background with mountains and buildings behind it.
To the left a component box is visible over a patch of brown and green grass adjacent to trees and bushes. In the background, a field is in front of mountains and a building during a sunny day.
A component box and antenna stand over a brown and somewhat green grassy area with green trees and foliage to the right. A field is in the background with mountains and buildings behind it.

Two representations of the same scene sit side by side in which a clear sky is visible with an instrument component is visible in the foreground. The left is the thermal representation and right is a standard image.
A dark, night sky in which silhouettes of treetops are visible under stars.
An area of grass and other foliage is illuminated at night with an instrument box and antenna visible in the foreground and a light in the background.
A component box and antenna stand over a brown and somewhat green grassy area with green trees and foliage to the right. A field is in the background with mountains and buildings behind it.
An ultra-wide view of the empty sky with an instrument visible in the foreground.
A blue sky with golden sun and wispy clouds over brown treetops with a metal component visible to the right.
Two images of the same scene of a starry night sky of which the left is the thermal representation and right the standard.
A dark, night scene of a grassy plain with instrument components visible to the left and trees and other vegetation to the right. In the background, lights are on.

A grey, overcast sky sits over a hills covered with some evergreen and other bare trees. In the middle of the scene is a house in a grassy area surrounded by a fence with piles of wood visible nearby. In the foreground are two pull-behind campers on gravel roads next to a shed surrounded by plains of green and brown grass.

A grey overcast sky over hills covered in evergreen and other trees which sit behind a building in a green, and some brown, grassy plain surrounded by a fence near wood piles. A car is parked on gravel roads next to pull-behind campers by a shed with wildflowers near.
A dark, night scene in which tree covered hills are in the background. In the foreground, two pull-behind campers next to a shed sit on gravel roads in a grassy plain.
A dark, rural scene in which trees are visible on hills in the background and a white pull-behind camper is parked in the foreground next to a shed.

A blue sky with clouds blocking the sun sits over a hills covered with some evergreen and other bare trees. In the middle of the scene is a house in a grassy area surrounded by a fence with piles of wood visible nearby. In the foreground are two pull-behind campers on gravel roads next to a shed surrounded by plains of green and brown grass.

A purple, grey cloudy sky over hills covered in evergreen and other trees which sit behind a building in a green, grassy plain surrounded by a fence near wood piles. Two cars are parked on gravel roads next to pull-behind campers by a shed with wildflowers near.

The blue sky has sparse clouds over a mountainous landscape. In the foreground, a chain-link fence separates a structure from a dirt area with green and brown vegetation. To the right is a mountainous area with dirt paths. An antenna is visible to the left.
A chain-link fence sits on a mountain on snow-covered dirt separating a structure from brown and green vegetation. An antenna is visible to the left while a grey, hazy cloud covers the background.
A grey, blue sky over rooftops to the left and treetops to the right with the sun peeking out behind them.
A dark, night scene in which trees, lights, and a building is visible in the background. A river with a dock separates the banks. The nearest bank is empty with a chain link fence to the left.

A road leads to a bridge with a boat parked nearby. On either side of the bridge are trees with leaves turning color and a house with car parked to the right. The river has remnants of river grass and lily pads on either side with a boat in the water on the near side. To the left, a chain-link fence separates a path from an area with grass and dirt and two sections of stripped docks on it.
An grey, overcast scene in which the rooftops of buildings are visible to the left and trees to the right.
A dark, grey sky covers the rooftops to the left and treetops to the right.
A clear, blue sky with golden sun hitting rooftops to the left and treetops to the right.
A grey, wet sky over rooftops of buildings to the left and treetops to the right.

Trees sit on either side of a road with vehicles parked nearby and driving down it toward a bridge over a river with a dock extending into it. On the far side of the riverbank are two buildings with cars parked nearby. On the near bank, a path near a chain-link fence with an empty area of dirt and grass goes into the water.
A blue, grey sky with rooftops to the left and treetops under the sun to the right.

A road leads to a bridge with a boat parked nearby. Either side of the road has trees with one side housing a building with cars parked nearby and a canoe on the far bank of the river. In the river are various boats and brown river grass near a dock. On the near bank a path is separated from a dirt and grassy area with four canoes situated on it by a chain-link fence.
A dark, night scene in which trees, lights, and a building is visible in the background. A river with a dock separates the banks. The nearest bank is empty with a chain link fence to the left.

A night scene of trees in the background to either side of a road leading to a bridge. A house with lights on sits among the trees. The river under the bridge has a dock in it and leads to a path behind a chain-link fence on the near bank.

Green trees sit on either side of a road with vehicles parked near bridge over a river with a dock extending into it. On the far side of the riverbank is a building with a car nearby and light on in the window. On the near bank, a path near a chain-link fence with an empty area of dirt and grass goes into the water. In the water, river grass and lily pads are visible.
A dark, night scene in which trees, lights, and a building is visible in the background. A river with a pier separates the banks. The nearest bank is empty with a chain link fence to the left.

A road leads to a bridge with a boat parked on it. Either side of the road is covered in luscious, green trees with a building and cars to the right. Under the bridge is a river with a dock in it and boat next to the dock. A chain-link fence separates a path to the dock from an area of grass and dirt. The river is filled with river grass and lily pads.
A dark, night scene in which trees, lights, and a building is visible in the background. A river with a pier separates the banks. The nearest bank is empty with a chain link fence to the left.
A blue sky with clouds over rooftops to the left and treetops to the right.
An grey, cloudy scene in which the rooftops of buildings are visible to the left and trees to the right.

A sunny scene of luscious, green trees on either side of a road with a vehicle near a bridge over a river with a bank in it. A chain-link fence separates a path from an area of green grass and dirt in front of which is river grass and lily pads on teh water.
A dark, night scene of trees in the background with light on. A river is the middle with a fence on the near bank separating a path from an empty area.

A road leads to a bridge with a boat parked nearby. Trees with fall leaves sit on either side and a house with a car parked near it is to the right of the far bank. In the river, lily pads are visible and a boat is in it. On the near bank, a chain-link fence separates a path from an area of dirt and grass with two sections of stripped dock, a canoe, and mesh structure on it.
A night scene in with clouds to one in an otherwise clear sky sit over silhouettes of mountains and reflection of water. An enclave of buildings sit in the foreground in a vast plain.

A dark, rural scene with a mountain in the background and structures with lights in the foreground among various trees. Vehicles, canoes, and a trailer are visible in the illuminated foreground in a grassy area.
A dark, night scene with treetops visible.
A mountain next to an expanse of water backs a brown, grassy plain before which sits an enclave of buildings with cars, boats, and a trailer on a lot.

Thin, wispy clouds are seen in a blue sky over a rural scene of snow-capped mountains in the background. In the foreground is a small enclave of buildings situated in an otherwise vast, open plain consisting of occasional trees, brown bushes and grass, and some snow.
A dark, night image of an instrument obscuring the scene and its thermal heat map representation.

A mostly overcast scene in which many buildings with vehicles and evergreen trees near them sit in the foreground on a blanket of snow. A hill is behind them on which stands an antenna and more trees. In the background, snow-capped mountains are visible. Something obscures the camera lens.
Two representations of the same scene sit side by side in which a wrapped extension cord is seen. On the left is the standard representation and the right has a heat map equivalent.
A sunny, blue sky with intermittent clouds covers mountains in the background and buildings in the foreground near trees, a hill, and antenna. A dust-devil appears to be obscuring the image.
Two representations of the same scene sit side by side in which a wrapped extension cord is seen. On the left is the standard representation and the right has a heat map equivalent.

A rural, overcast scene in which snow-capped mountains sit behind a vast, open plain of brown grass and vegetation. In the foreground is a small enclave of buildings with vehicles parked nearby, fencing, and some snow visible.
Billowing clouds in a blue sky cover mountains in the background while an enclave of buildings sit in open, green grassy plains.

A standard image and thermal equivalent are side by side in which an object obscures the scene. A building sits in the background before trees and preceded by a fence. In the foreground, the back of a pull-behind camper is visible on a gravel road near a brown and green grassy area.

A mostly overcast scene in which many buildings with vehicles and evergreen trees near them sit in the foreground in grassy areas. A hill is behind them on which stands an antenna and more trees. In the background, snow-capped mountains are visible.
